faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover SDV8 use?
faqLeft.a: The Range Rover SDV8 uses the TDV8/SDV8 — a 4.4-litre V8 diesel engine. It was fitted to the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) generations.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover SDV8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SDV8?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Range Rover SDV8 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo components, and gaskets as standard on every SDV8 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover SDV8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover SDV8 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover SDV8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover SDV8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
